fusions.name: Stamped Warning
fusions.desc: A foot-drummed alarm that deals 25 resonating damage to everything within 4 tiles ahead of you. Every ally deals 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Parting Kick
fusions.desc: A parting back-kick that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: White-Flag Bolt
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 6 seconds, springs you 3 tiles from where you stood, and gives you 8% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Flinch Reflex
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
